title: net2 on net1 v4: online checkpoints and the share rule against the fixed rule, on validation links
description: Every checkpoint (iterations 10, 20, 30, 40) of the four online runs of exp-net2v4-online-15, and the share rule (experiments/share_rule_export.py: u = 0.125 + k busy max(0, 1 - receive/capacity) from net1 v4's means, k in {0.5, 1, 2, 3}), next to the fixed rule on net1 v4 at u = 0.125 and BBRv3, on the 21 validation links under the five validation families (experiments/heldout.py, campaign seed 11), as the rule's u was chosen in exp-rule-net1v4-val-11. The best online checkpoint and the best share rule, by mean difference from BBRv3 over the five campaigns, are chosen (chosen.json); the test links are not touched.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u 0.125; uv run python experiments/share_rule_export.py "$OUT/share" "$G" --u0 0.125 --k 0.5 1 2 3; P=(--policy "rule-v4=$OUT/v4/rule-u0.125.onnx"); for k in 0.5 1 2 3; do P+=(--policy "share-k$k=$OUT/share/share-u0.125-k$k.onnx"); done; for f in "$IN"/online/net2-*/iter*/policy-updated.onnx; do run=$(basename "$(dirname "$(dirname "$f")")"); it=$(basename "$(dirname "$f")"); it=${it#iter}; P+=(--policy "$run-i$((10#$it + 1))=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 11 11 bbr3 "${P[@]}"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --best net2 share
